facts.claim_en: The U.S. Department of Labor's table of state meal-period laws lists, for California, a 30-minute meal period when work is more than 5 hours a day (with limited exceptions).

facts.source_name: U.S. Department of Labor, Minimum Length of Meal Period Required Under State Law
facts.quote: ½ hour, if work is for more than 5 hours per day
